response.final_analysis: Misoprostol is the drug of choice for peptic ulcer disease caused by chronic NSAID use due to its dual action of reducing gastric acid secretion and enhancing mucosal protection by mimicking prostaglandins. This addresses the primary pathophysiological changes induced by NSAIDs.
